title: Fix the Binary Search
description:
The following binary search implementation has a bug. Identify and fix it.

The function should return the index of target in a sorted array, or -1 if not found.
constraints:
Array is sorted in ascending order.
1 <= nums.length <= 10^4
bug_description: The bug is in `left = mid` — it should be `left = mid + 1`. Without the +1, the loop can infinite-loop when left == mid. Also `right = len(nums)` should be `len(nums) - 1` for inclusive bounds, or keep exclusive but adjust the logic.

title: Fix the Fibonacci Function
description: The following recursive Fibonacci implementation has bugs. Fix it so it correctly returns the nth Fibonacci number (0-indexed: fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1).
bug_description: Two bugs: (1) fib(0) should return 0, not 1. (2) The recursive call should be fibonacci(n-2), not fibonacci(n-3).

title: Fix the Bubble Sort
description: The following bubble sort implementation doesn't sort correctly. Find and fix the bug.
bug_description: The swap is incorrect — it needs a temporary variable or tuple swap. The current code overwrites arr[j] before using its old value for arr[j+1]. Fix: use arr[j], arr[j+1] = arr[j+1], arr[j].
hints: Look at the swap logic carefully.

title: Fix the Stack Implementation
description: The following stack implementation has a bug in the pop method. Fix it.
bug_description: The pop method uses pop(0) which removes from the front (queue behavior). Stack should pop from the end: self.items.pop() without argument.
hints: Stack is LIFO. Where should pop remove from?

test_cases.input:
push 1
push 2
push 3
pop
pop
peek

title: Fix the Merge Sort
description: The following merge sort has a bug in the merge function. Find and fix it.
bug_description: The merge function doesn't append remaining elements from left or right after one list is exhausted. Need to add result.extend(left[i:]) and result.extend(right[j:]) at the end.
hints: What happens to remaining elements after the while loop?
